# Canonical lifecycle schema

Schema version: **1**.

Stable IDs, reason classes, and the schema version are persisted meanings. Labels are presentation only.

## States

| State | Classification | Terminal | Cancel eligible | Reconciliation | Exit | Presentation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| queued | active | no | yes | not required | — | pending |
| preparing | active | no | yes | not required | — | progress |
| running | active | no | yes | not required | — | progress |
| awaiting_input | interrupt | no | yes | not required | — | waiting |
| cancel_requested | interrupt | no | no | not required | — | stopping |
| verifying | active | no | yes | not required | — | progress |
| completed | terminal | yes | no | required | 0 | success |
| partial | terminal | yes | no | required | 3 | warning |
| blocked | terminal | yes | no | required | 4 | warning |
| failed | terminal | yes | no | required | 2 | error |
| cancelled | terminal | yes | no | required | 130 | neutral |
| timeout | terminal | yes | no | required | 5 | warning |
| needs_attention | terminal | yes | no | required | 6 | degraded |

`cancel_requested` is non-terminal. `cancelled` is terminal only after reconciliation.
Unknown schema, state, or legacy status data degrades to terminal `needs_attention` with incompatible compatibility and no automatic retry.

## Reason classes

| Reason | Detail required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lifecycle_progress | no | Normal forward lifecycle progress. |
| input_requested | yes | The run paused for user input or authority. |
| input_resumed | no | User input resumed the same run. |
| cancellation_requested | no | Cancellation was acknowledged but teardown is not reconciled. |
| terminal_resolution | yes | Observed evidence reconciled the run to a terminal result. |
| verification_repair | yes | Verification found work that must return to execution for repair. |
